### 2026-10-07 — October  7th : Wiring the Starbie schematic

**1.48h**

October  7th : Wiring the Starbie schematic

I worked on the KiCad schematic for the Starbie project. Today  I finished the remaining of the design of the schematic by doing the OLED section, MPU6050 section and DHT11 environmental sensor. I then  started organising the circuit into separate sections so that the connections between the components would be easier to understand for the later sections.

### 2026-10-07 — October 7th :

**1.5h**

October 7th :

    I researched what  SCL, SDA and GPIO are to  help me understand what  the connections in my tutorial guide meant . I understood that SCL is the I²C clock line and SDA carries data between devices. I also learned that GPIO pins can be used for different inputs and outputs.
